elements.name: Pump Station Operations
elements.description: Fixture-only operational layer for the pump-station blueprint.

elements.name: Operator
elements.description: Monitors the station and acknowledges alarms.

elements.name: Maintenance Engineer
elements.description: Reviews events and investigates station faults.

elements.name: Monitor Pump Station
elements.description: Observe current pump and communication state.

elements.name: Respond to Pressure Alarm
elements.description: Detect, display, acknowledge, and retain a pressure alarm.

elements.name: Review Event History
elements.description: Review retained events for operations and maintenance.

elements.name: Observe Station State
elements.description: Observe current state in the HMI.

elements.name: Acknowledge Alarm
elements.description: Operator acknowledges a latched alarm.

elements.name: Review Events
elements.description: Maintenance engineer reviews the retained event log.

elements.name: Pump Station Monitoring System Analysis
elements.description: Fixture-only system-analysis layer.

elements.name: Pump Station Monitoring System
elements.description: System under analysis.

elements.name: Sensor Gateway
elements.description: Provides Modbus TCP telemetry.

elements.name: Pump Controller
elements.description: Controls pump operation and exposes state.

elements.name: Operator
elements.description: External operator at system-analysis level.

elements.name: Acquire Telemetry
elements.description: Acquire Modbus TCP telemetry on a 500 ms cycle.

elements.name: Validate Measurements
elements.description: Validate freshness and plausibility before state changes.

elements.name: Determine Pump State
elements.description: Derive a stable pump state from validated measurements.

elements.name: Evaluate Pressure Threshold
elements.description: Compare pressure with the configured alarm threshold.

elements.name: Manage Alarm Lifecycle
elements.description: Latch, display, acknowledge, and clear alarms safely.

elements.name: Store Event
elements.description: Persist UTC-stamped events for at least 30 days.

elements.name: Publish HMI State
elements.description: Publish pump and alarm state within the latency budget.

elements.name: Raw Telemetry
elements.description: Unvalidated telemetry from the sensor gateway.

elements.name: Validated Measurement
elements.description: Measurement with validity and freshness information.

elements.name: Pump State
elements.description: Derived pump operating state.

elements.name: Alarm Event
elements.description: Pressure or communication alarm event.

elements.name: Acknowledgement
elements.description: Operator acknowledgement command.

elements.name: Event Record
elements.description: UTC-stamped event record for persistence.

elements.name: HMI Update
elements.description: Current state sent to the operator HMI.

elements.name: Pressure Alarm Handling
elements.description: End-to-end detection, latching, publication, and persistence chain.

elements.name: Maintain Safe Pump Operation
elements.description: Keep operators informed and preserve alarms despite invalid data.

elements.name: High Pressure Alarm Scenario
elements.description: Pressure rises, an alarm latches, the operator acknowledges it, and the event is stored.

elements.name: Pump Station Logical Architecture
elements.description: Fixture-only logical component decomposition.

elements.name: Telemetry Adapter
elements.description: Owns protocol polling and telemetry acquisition.

elements.name: State Processor
elements.description: Validates data and derives pump state.

elements.name: Alarm Manager
elements.description: Evaluates thresholds and manages the alarm lifecycle.

elements.name: Event Store
elements.description: Persists event records for the retention period.

elements.name: HMI Service
elements.description: Publishes current state and receives acknowledgement.
